bull_bear.body:
- Technology-led execution: MIVAN aluminium formwork is stated to accelerate construction, improve precision and quality, reduce material wastage and enhance project turnaround
- Project-level policy recognition: AGI UTOPIA recognised under the Iconic Building of Punjab Policy of the Government of Punjab, which the MD states provides benefits on approval fees and associated costs
- Captive rooftop solar generation installed in a developed project, together with dual plumbing, to reduce electricity and ground-water consumption
- Skilling tie-up with the Construction Skill Development Council of India (CSDCI) towards a Centre of Excellence in Punjab
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Single-activity concentration in Group Housing development — The energy-conservation disclosure states the Company 'is engaged in the development of Group Housing', so earnings depend on one activity and on residential demand, with no disclosed diversification outside real estate.
- Cyclical demand and pricing in the Company's principal markets — The cautionary statement names cyclical demand and pricing in principal markets, and global and Indian demand-supply conditions, as factors that could make results differ materially from management's projections.
- Input and finished-goods price movement — The cautionary statement names finished goods prices among the important factors that could materially change the Company's operations.
- Regulatory and tax-regime change — The cautionary statement names changes in Government regulations and tax regimes as factors that could materially affect operations — material for a developer dependent on project approvals.
- Litigation and labour negotiations — The cautionary statement explicitly lists litigation and labor negotiations among the factors that could make a difference to the Company's operations.
- Electricity dependence and rising power cost — The Company states electricity is the only mode of energy, purchased from Punjab State Electricity Board and supplemented by its own generators, and that the cost of electricity is accelerating every year; mitigation is rooftop solar, LED lighting, A/C lift drives, sub-meters and dual plumbing.
- Stated dependence on seasonal agricultural produce (disclosure appears inconsistent with the business) — The Risk Management Policy section states the Company's 'business is significantly dependent on agricultural produce, which is highly seasonal' and that this may affect consumers' purchasing power. This is the only risk the Board's risk-management section names, but it contradicts the report's own description of the Company as a Group Housing developer, so it is recorded as disclosed and flagged as inconsistent rather than adopted as a finding.
- Non-applicability of BRSR reporting for FY 2025-26 — The report states Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reporting under Regulation 34(2) does not apply to the Company for FY 2025-26, so no BRSR material-issues table, concentration disclosure or assured ESG metrics are available to assess risk against.

outlook.body:
- Selective geographic expansion into carefully chosen high-potential markets, having extended into Ludhiana (after AGI Sky Villas, via a 60% stake in World Next Realty LLP) and New Chandigarh (AGI UTOPIA launch)
- Adoption of MIVAN aluminium formwork technology to accelerate construction, improve precision and quality, reduce material wastage and improve project turnaround
- Development of skilled construction manpower, including a tie-up with the Construction Skill Development Council of India (CSDCI) towards a Centre of Excellence in Punjab, plus in-house and external training of technical and project teams
- Prudent financial management: maintaining adequate liquidity, focusing on healthy customer collections and working with lending partners to optimise the cost of project finance
- Improving internal systems and processes as scale increases, to raise efficiency and control costs without compromising quality or customer satisfaction
- Sustainable development across projects through plantation and greenery initiatives, solar rooftop installations and rainwater harvesting
outlook.title: Strategy & capital allocation

outlook.body: Expansion is described only in the MD's message. As of March 2026 the Company reports approximately 16.8 million square feet under construction, with a pipeline of approximately 7.9 million square feet scheduled for launch in the near future (planned launches, not yet under construction). Geographic expansion is through carefully selected markets: following completion of AGI Sky Villas at Ludhiana, the Company strengthened its Ludhiana presence by acquiring a 60% stake in World Next Realty LLP (acquired 12 March 2026), and entered New Chandigarh with the launch of AGI UTOPIA, which has been recognised under the Iconic Building of Punjab Policy of the Government of Punjab — a recognition management says brings project-level benefits on approval fees and associated costs. Execution capability is being upgraded through MIVAN aluminium formwork technology, and the Company has joined hands with the Construction Skill Development Council of India to work towards establishing a Centre of Excellence in Punjab (an intention, not a commissioned facility). The Directors' Report states a QIP of Rs.7500 Lakhs was raised in the quarter ended 31 March 2026, of which Rs.5600 Lakhs was earmarked for investment in construction of ongoing projects, with part of the proceeds still unutilised at 31 March 2026. A rooftop solar generation system has been set up in a project developed by the Company, along with dual plumbing, to cut electricity and ground-water use; no capacity figure is disclosed for it. No capacity table and no named capex disclosure appear in this bundle.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- MD claims the Indian real estate sector is becoming increasingly organised, transparent and quality-driven and remains an important contributor to the economy
- MD cites the Economic Survey 2025-26 that real estate and ownership of dwellings has contributed approximately 7% of India's Gross Value Added on average over the past decade
- MD claims a clear shift in customer expectations towards better quality, modern amenities, professionally executed developments, sustainability and trusted brands, which management believes creates opportunity for players combining strong execution with financial discipline and customer confidence
- MD states the Company is conscious of the cyclical nature of real estate and of risks from changes in interest rates, construction costs, market demand and regulatory conditions
- MD states management remains optimistic about the long-term prospects of the Indian real estate sector (a management claim, not a forecast)
- Approximately 16.8 million square feet under construction as of March 2026 (MD's message)
- Pipeline of approximately 7.9 million square feet scheduled for launch in the near future — planned launches, not under construction (MD's message)

deepdive.thesis: AGI Infra Limited is a Punjab-based real-estate developer of group housing and commercial space, with approximately 16.8 million square feet under construction as of March 2026.

open.item: A pipeline of approximately 7.9 million square feet is scheduled for launch in the near future (planned, undated).

Of the Rs.7500 Lakhs QIP raised in the quarter ended 31 March 2026, the placement document earmarked Rs.5600 Lakhs for investment in construction of ongoing projects and Rs.1825 Lakhs for general corporate purposes, part of which remained unutilised at 31 March 2026.
The Company has joined hands with the Construction Skill Development Council of India to work towards establishing a Centre of Excellence in Punjab.

Management states its focus will remain on selective expansion, timely project execution, prudent financial management, adoption of technology, development of skilled manpower, customer-centricity and sustainable growth.
The Company intends to work with the Construction Skill Development Council of India towards establishing a Centre of Excellence in the State of Punjab.

Management explicitly flags the cyclical nature of real estate and risks from changes in interest rates, construction costs, market demand and regulatory conditions, and says it will maintain adequate liquidity and healthy customer collections in response.
Rs.5600 Lakhs of the Rs.7500 Lakhs QIP was earmarked per the placement document for investment in construction of ongoing projects, with a portion still unutilised at 31 March 2026.
Approximately 7.9 million square feet is scheduled for launch in the near future — a planned pipeline with no stated date.
The Company intends to work towards establishing a Centre of Excellence in Punjab with the Construction Skill Development Council of India.
